description: This file defines the NetworkingTrace class, which implements diagnostic and logging functionalities for networking components within Orleans. It extends DiagnosticListener and implements ILogger, providing methods for scope management, log level checking, and logging messages.

classes.name: NetworkingTrace
classes.description: A sealed class that provides diagnostic and logging capabilities for networking within Orleans, extending DiagnosticListener and implementing ILogger.

methods.name: NetworkingTrace
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger using a provided ILoggerFactory and sets up the DiagnosticListener with the class name.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Begins a logical operation scope for logging, delegating to the internal ILogger instance.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level is enabled for logging.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level, event ID, state, exception, and formatter.
